articles.title: Ceasefire extended across Ukraine's Kherson region, officials say
articles.description: The truce was originally planned for the stranded residents of Oleshky, and Russia and Ukraine say no breaches have been reported.

articles.title: Watch: What happens now after close vote in Israeli election?
articles.description: Polls have closed in the Israeli election, but there is no clear winner.

articles.title: What does Israel's election mean for Gaza and the wider world?
articles.description: The BBC's diplomatic correspondent James Landale reports from Jerusalem as ballots are cast.

articles.title: Knife attacker shot dead by police outside Israeli embassy
articles.description: A man carrying knives has been killed by police after attacking an officer outside the Israeli embassy in Belgrade.

articles.title: Flavio Bolsonaro flies from Argentina after Brazil election defeat
articles.description: Argentina has said Flavio Bolsonaro entered the country before boarding a private flight to Ecuador on Tuesday after losing Brazil's presidential election.

articles.title: Zookeeper dies after being attacked by leopard
articles.description: A woman has died after being attacked by a leopard at the safari park where she spent almost her entire 40-year career.

articles.title: At least 62 killed and thousands displaced in gunmen attack in Nigeria
articles.description: At least 62 people have been killed after an attack in northeastern Nigeria, the country's emergency agency said.
